name: Spring Lake Day Camp
description_short: Family run day camp on a 30 acre campus in Ringwood for nursery age children through 10th grade, with a five pool complex, a spring fed lake for boating and fishing, a zip line, ropes courses, field and court sports, arts, cooking and science. Full day runs 9:00 to 4:00; a half day Mini Day program serves 3 and 4 year olds.
notes: 2027 tuition for New Jersey families runs from $5,995 (Mini Day, second 4 weeks) to $10,595 (an 8 week full day session); 5, 6 and 7 week options are also offered. Tuition includes door to door minibus transport in most areas, hot lunch and two snacks. $500 deposit, refundable until 12/1/2026. Sibling discounts of $300 to $1,000. Camp is closed Monday July 5.
